label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.2 a.3…: There is something maximally being that is the cause…
locator: I q.2 a.3 co., quarta via: Ergo est aliquid quod omnibus entibus est causa esse, et bonitatis, et cuiuslibet perfectionis
interpretation: Only 'causa esse' is formalized: something maximal in being causes the being of every other being. The clauses 'et bonitatis, et cuiuslibet perfectionis' are not derived by the formal argument: the genus principle applied to goodness yields a maximum in goodness, but nothing in the text makes it the same being as the maximum in being (the unity of the maxima). Derived in result AQUINAS-ST-I-Q2-A3-QUARTA-VIA.
